# VDO.Ninja SDK

Vendored from https://github.com/steveseguin/ninjasdk

- Version: 1.6.2
- Commit: `2a846f37512e711ca3ab9be8fb391a867d0614e9`
- File: `vdoninja-sdk.js` (unmodified)
- License: Mozilla Public License 2.0; see `LICENSE-MPL-2.0.txt`.

The SDK contacts VDO.Ninja hosted signaling and its STUN/TURN services. Same Scene uses documented SDK APIs; it does not connect to their signaling protocol directly. Free service access remains subject to VDO.Ninja's terms, availability and limits.
